name: crafter-station-skills
description: Agent Skills for context engineering and agentic workflows. Battle-tested patterns from production codebases.

plugins.name: intent-layer
plugins.description: Set up hierarchical AGENTS.md infrastructure so agents navigate codebases like senior engineers. Use for new projects needing context structure or existing repos that need better agent performance.
plugins.author: Railly Hugo

plugins.name: skill-gen
plugins.description: Auto-generate agent skills from documentation using Firecrawl. Ask Claude to research any docs or pass a URL directly - it extracts patterns, generates SKILL.md with proper frontmatter, and creates reference files. Use when you need a skill for an API, framework, or tool but don't want to write it manually.
plugins.author: Railly Hugo

plugins.name: skillkit
plugins.description: Local-first analytics for AI agent skills. Tracks usage with sparklines, measures context budget, and prunes unused skills. Supports Claude Code and OpenCode.
plugins.author: Railly Hugo

plugins.name: supply-chain-audit
plugins.description: Read-only audit of a developer machine for npm/PyPI supply-chain compromise. Scans for known IOCs from Shai-Hulud 2.0 (Nov 2025), Mini Shai-Hulud / TeamPCP (May 2026), Axios DPRK (Mar 2026), and any future campaigns added to the IOC pack. Produces a PASS/FAIL verdict, IOC checklist, at-risk package list, and 48h bake-period remediation. Never modifies files.
plugins.author: Railly Hugo

plugins.name: generate-brand-assets
plugins.description: Generate OG images and favicon based on project branding. Creates correctly sized social media preview images (1200×630px) for Twitter, LinkedIn, and Facebook, plus favicon formats (16-512px). Supports brand color palettes, gradients, text customization, and multiple formats (PNG, WebP, ICO). Outputs ready-to-integrate assets for web and mobile apps.
plugins.author: Crafter Station

plugins.name: obsidian-plugin-release
plugins.description: Release a new version of an Obsidian community plugin without forgetting steps. Bumps version atomically across manifest.json + package.json + versions.json, builds, lints, commits, signs an annotated tag, and lets a GitHub Actions workflow publish the release with build-provenance attestation (SLSA in-toto). Idempotent and dry-run-safe. Includes scaffold for the release workflow and an eslint config that passes the new Obsidian Community automated review.
plugins.author: Railly Hugo
